description:
Free (never charged): how much this key can still spend, so you can
    stop before a 402 instead of discovering it mid-sequence — the MCP
    counterpart of the REST X-AANet-Remaining-Balance header. Takes only the
    key; works for the owner_key or any sub-key, against itself.

    Returns `remaining` (what you can actually spend: the lower of the two
    limits below), `key_budget_remaining` (this key's budget_cap minus what it
    has spent; null if the key has no cap), `key_window_remaining` (units left
    under the key's spend_limit_per_hour/day, whichever is tighter; null if it
    has neither) and `workspace_balance` (the shared workspace balance), all in
    raw integer units ($0.00001 each). `remaining` is the lowest of the three.
    Comparing them tells you which one runs out first.

api_key.description: Bearer credential for this workspace: either the owner_key returned once by aanet_create_workspace/aanet_create_trial_workspace, or a sub-key returned by aanet_mint_subkey. Sent under the hood as `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`. Owner-only tools reject a sub-key with a 403.
api_key.title: Api Key

name: aanet_get_remaining_balance
